title: Technical Lead - DevSecOps
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:** 
 In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large\-scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 Engineering Manager \- Development is responsible for building a team of highly skilled and high performing software developers. They should be adept in designing highly scalable architectures in cloud native environments and, should work closely with Head of Product Engineering to achieve outcomes. They should be proficient in at least two programming languages like Node.js / Python / Java.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Adani Group:** 
 In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world\-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan\-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large\-scale infrastructure development in India with O \& M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG\-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
   

  

**Job Purpose:** 
 Senior DevOps Engineer will be responsible for implementing and managing secure DevOps practices, focusing on automating processes, securing infrastructure, and optimizing workflows within a dynamic and evolving environment. They will will work closely with cross\-functional teams, ensuring the integration of security into every aspect of the DevOps lifecycle to build resilient, secure, and scalable systems.
   

  

* Key Responsibilities of Role


**Senior DevOps Engineer \- IC**
**Automation And CI/CD Optimization**
 Design, create and optimize CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, contribute to the templatization framework and make sure most pipeline code is reusable across various microservices, implementing best practices for efficiency and reliability.
   

  

**Infrastructure As Code (IaC)**
 Create Terraform Modules that are reusable in various implementation Infrastructure as Code (IAC). Modules have to follow best practices and security guidelines concurred internally. Use Ansible for configuration management and automation of server setups (TSDB, PGPool, Looker VM etc.), ensuring consistency across environments.
   

  

**Containerization And Orchestration**
 Implement secure containerization using tools like Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring security best practices (e.g., secure image scanning, role\-based access control).
   

  

 Automate deployment processes for containerized applications in a secure and efficient manner. Manage complex Kubernetes clusters, including advanced networking, security, and resource management. Create and maintain Helm charts for complex Kubernetes orchestration
   

  

**Cloud Security**
 Work with cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) to design secure cloud infrastructure, ensuring compliance with security frameworks and best practices.
   

  

 Implement security controls such as encryption, IAM, and network security in cloud environments.
   

  

**Incident Response And Threat Detection**
 Investigate and mitigate security incidents and vulnerabilities in a timely and efficient manner.
   

  

 Collaborate with security teams to identify, analyze, and patch security vulnerabilities within the CI/CD pipeline and infrastructure.
   

  

**Collaboration With Development And Security Teams**
 Work closely with developers to ensure security is integrated from the beginning of the development lifecycle.
   

  

 Collaborate with cybersecurity professionals to ensure the infrastructure and applications meet compliance standards.
   

  

**Documentation And Reporting**
 Document the DevOps processes, security procedures, and compliance reports.
   

  

 Ensure accurate and timely reporting of security status and activities to stakeholders and management.
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**
 Department Heads
   

  

 IT Team
   

  

 Product Management Team
   

  

 Risk Management Teams
   

  

 Project Management Office (PMO)
   

  

 Human Resources
   

  

**Key Stakeholders \- External**
 Cloud Service Providers
   

  

 Third\-Party Vendors \& Consultants
   

  

 Regulatory Bodies
   

  

 External Auditors
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber, Information Security, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
   

  

 Strong understanding of DevOps principles and practices.
   

  

 Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash).
   

  

 Knowledge of automation tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, Jenkins).
   

  

 Experience with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack).
   

  

 Understanding of network protocols and security best practices.
   

  

 Significant experience in implementing and managing CI/CD pipelines.
   

  

 Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) and configuration management.
   

  

 Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
   

  

 Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
   

  

**Certification**
 AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, or other relevant certifications.
   

  

**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
 5\+ years of experience in DevOps, with at least 2 years in leading DevOps role.

title: Team Lead - Group Vigilance
description:
**Responsibilities**
* Lead and conduct complex, high‑impact investigations into alleged fraud, misconduct, and policy violations, ensuring independence, objectivity, and adherence to due process
* 
* Oversee the end\-to\-end whistleblower program, including intake, triaging, investigation, and resolution while maintaining confidentiality and integrity
* 
* Prepare detailed investigation reports, present findings to senior leadership and governance forums, and recommend corrective and preventive actions
* 
* Drive cross\-functional collaboration with Legal, HR, Finance, Compliance, and senior management to ensure effective closure and implementation of investigation outcomes
* 
* Strengthen the organization's fraud risk management and integrity framework by designing preventive controls and monitoring mechanisms
* 
* Identify emerging risks related to financial crime, fraud, and misconduct, and recommend mitigation strategies
* 
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, corporate governance standards, and internal codes of conduct
* 
* Lead awareness initiatives, trainings, and communication programs to promote an ethics\-driven culture across the organization
* 
* Provide periodic reporting and insights to leadership, audit committees, and governance bodies
* 
* Mentor and guide junior team members, fostering a high\-performance and integrity\-led team environment


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Law, or related discipline (Master's degree preferred)
* 
* 8–15\+ years of relevant experience in fraud risk management, forensic investigations, ethics \& compliance, or internal audit
* 
* Professional certifications such as CFE (Certified Fraud Examiner), CA, CIA, or certifications in Risk, Compliance, or Ethics \& Governance preferred
* 
* Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks, corporate governance practices, forensic investigation techniques, and internal control systems
* 
* Proven experience in handling sensitive investigations and stakeholder management at senior levels
* 
* Exposure to whistleblower frameworks, financial crime prevention, and compliance programs
* 
* Ongoing training or certifications in investigations, compliance, or risk management will be an added advantage

 Your profile

* 8–12 years of IT experience with strong expertise in DevOps, enterprise application support, automation, and production service management.

* Strong documentation skills, including development and maintenance of SOPs, runbooks, knowledge articles, and training materials.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced production support environment, including shift\-based operations, release windows, critical incidents, and priority business escalations.

title: Deputy Manager, IT User Support
description:
**Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The role is responsible for providing expert\-level day\-to\-day technical support to employees across hardware and software systems, with a strong focus on complex troubleshooting, fault rectification, and timely resolution. The role independently diagnoses and resolves advanced issues, ensures effective escalation and coordination when required, and contributes to root\-cause analysis to prevent recurrence. The role maintains high service quality and SLA adherence, ensures accurate documentation, and upholds IT policies and information security practices, while serving as a technical authority without people\-management responsibility.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Resolve complex hardware and software issues independently
* Transition from hands\-on technical support to leading IT user support operations, driving team performance, SLA adherence, and service delivery excellence
* Perform advanced troubleshooting and fault rectification
* Manage escalations and coordinate with specialist teams
* Ensure timely incident closure in line with SLAs
* Conduct root\-cause analysis and recommend preventive actions
* Maintain detailed incident and resolution documentation
* Support system access, configurations, and device setups
* Ensure adherence to IT policies and security standards
* Contribute to continuous improvement of support processes


**Job Responsibilities – Plant It Lead**
* Plant IT Leadership \& Service Delivery: Lead end\-to\-end IT operations and service delivery for the plant, covering Quality Informatics, Manufacturing Informatics, IT Infrastructure, End User Computing, and Information Security.
* Quality \& Manufacturing Informatics: Provide techno\-functional leadership and support for QC laboratory and manufacturing computerized systems, including LIMS, Empower, and equipment control systems, ensuring availability, compliance, qualification, and effective lifecycle management.
* Plant IT Infrastructure: Own and manage plant\-level LAN/WAN, servers, network, firewalls, Wi\-Fi, internet connectivity, server rooms, storage, backup, and end\-user computing infrastructure to ensure reliable and uninterrupted business operations.
* Information Security: Ensure implementation and monitoring of endpoint security, OS\-level access controls, logical access, patch management, vulnerability remediation, local firewall controls, and other applicable information security requirements.
* Regulatory Compliance \& Audits: Act as the Plant IT SPOC for regulatory and customer audits and ensure compliance with GxP, SOX, Data Privacy, ISMS, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
* IT Governance \& SOP Management: Establish, implement, and maintain Plant IT SOPs, procedures, standards, controls, and governance frameworks in coordination with Quality and relevant business functions.
* IT Projects \& Digitization: Lead plant\-level IT projects, infrastructure upgrades, digital transformation, automation, productivity improvement, cost optimization, and technology initiatives in alignment with business requirements.
* Vendor \& Partner Management: Manage IT vendors and service partners, including performance monitoring, SLA/OLA compliance, escalation management, technical evaluation, and contract/service governance.
* Business Continuity \& Disaster Recovery: Ensure effective implementation, monitoring, and periodic testing of backup, high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions for critical plant IT systems.
* Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop the Plant IT team, allocate resources effectively, drive accountability, and ensure timely resolution of IT incidents, service requests, and business requirements.
* Stakeholder Management: Work closely with Plant Leadership, Quality, Manufacturing, Engineering, EHS, HR, Finance, Corporate IT, Cybersecurity, and other functions to understand requirements and deliver effective IT solutions.
* IT Service Performance: Monitor Plant IT performance through SLA/OLA, incident management, problem management, service availability, MTTR, and user satisfaction, ensuring continuous improvement of IT services.
* Technology \& Infrastructure Planning: Work closely with the Head – IT Infrastructure \& Information Security on IT strategy, capacity planning, technology roadmap, budgeting, CAPEX/OPEX planning, and infrastructure standardization across the plant.
* CSV / Computerized System Compliance: Provide support for computerized system validation lifecycle activities, including assessment, qualification, change management, periodic review, and retirement of GxP\-relevant computerized systems.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, standardization, cost optimization, and technology modernization to improve plant productivity, quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.


**Education**
**QUALIFICATIONS**
* Bachelors Degree (BA/BS) B.Tech \- Required
* Master Degree (MS/MA) M.Tech \- Preferred


**Experience:**
* 8 years or more in 8 \- 10 Years


**Specialized Knowledge:** 
**Licenses:**
